page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.re6.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs provided by an Intel Xeon 8269CL processor. The instance is configured with 512.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 16.0 GB per core.

This instance type does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. It also lacks dedicated GPU hardware accelerators. The baseline network bandwidth is rated at 10 Gbps, and the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the high memory density relative to the vCPU count, the ecs.re6.8xlarge offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring large in-memory datasets without the need for proportional scaling of compute resources. This hardware profile is suitable for in-memory databases, large-scale caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and memory-intensive data processing applications.
